description: Accounts in Judaeo-Arabic. The pages are headed by partial dates that seem like phrases from legal documents (lammā kāna bi-taʾrīkh. . .). One is dated Tishrei 1696 Seleucid = September/October 1384 CE (the units digit is not entirely clear but 169[.] is quite clear). The main text on the pages consists of tables of names along with numbers and sometimes the notation "baṭṭāl" (unemployed). Distribution list?
